description: Create a new Google Docs document with the given title and optional initial plain-text content. Runs as a background job: dispatch returns a job_id immediately, and the new document's id arrives via a follow-up message once creation completes. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Create a brand-new Google Docs document with a given title as a background job, optionally seeding it with plain-text content inserted at the start of the body. Dispatch returns a job_id for tracking; completion delivers the document's id, which is then the 'id' argument for docs_get, docs_batch_update, and docs_export.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Job queued for the document creation; completion will be delivered automatically.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Return exactly one action using the active IO plugin's post_message (process_key: plugin::<io_plugin>::post_message). Use the provided session_id. Keep the message short and friendly. Do NOT invent process identifiers (no present_result, no status actions).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Dispatch a background job to create a new Google Docs document.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing title, or missing session_id/flow_id context. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked. gsuite.api_error: AsyncJobManager unavailable or job creation failed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: supply a title. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account. gsuite.api_error: retry once platform startup has completed.
